propositions: code-review-verify scorer emits {verifications: [...]} output with no decision polarity, causing _verdict_decision to map all cases to advisory regardless of gold label
the V-real-defect gold-block case is guaranteed to be scored as advisory, creating a symmetric recall miss on both standard and frontier arms
mapping non-empty verifications list to block would fix the recall miss but simultaneously mis-score the V-clean-rename gold-advisory case as block, creating a false accept
code-review-verify must be excluded from the parity corpus by a separate named mechanism distinct from AGENTIC_SOLVERS to avoid future silent re-admission of mis-scored cases
offline re-scoring with the exclusion raises recall from 0.857 to 0.923 on standard and 0.929 to 1.000 on frontier without changing any gating verdicts or false-accept outcome
the gold floor remains satisfied after exclusion (n_gold 28 to 26, still above MIN_GOLD_ITEMS 20)
